entry.author: Ministry for Pacific Peoples
entry.summary:
Watch as Mama Tangi guides us through this quick and easy recipe, passed down through generations. 

🍌🌴🥥Poi Meika, the Cook Islands Banana Smoothie! ✨ 
Simply mash a ripe banana and blend in the rich coconut cream – a delicious tropical delight that brings the Cook Islands right to your home! 🏝️😍🍹 Whether it's a sunny morning or a relaxing afternoon, enjoy this refreshing smoothie any day of the week! 🌞💚 

#PoiMeika #CookIslandsFlavours #TropicalDelight #CookIslandsHeritage #SmoothieLovers #CookIslandsLanguageWeek 🍌🌺🥥

Resources and calendar of events found right here:
https://www.mpp.govt.nz/programmes/pacific-language-weeks/cook-islands-language-week/
